import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# Put a valid ancillary chunk before IDAT and then a malformed critical chunk after it.
text=chunk(b'tEXt', b'k\x00v')
raw=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))
# malformed critical chunk type 'ABCD' (critical because first letter uppercase) after IDAT
badcrit=chunk(b'ABCD', b'1234')
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
poc=sig+ihdr+text+idat+badcrit+iend
pathlib.Path('badcrit_after.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
PY
